messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: [SEV2] inference-prod - elevated 5xx rate and queue depth on /v1/generate. Pager sent to @ben. Incident link: https://incidents.redwood/2498765432

ben: ACK. jumping in. tagging @maya and @alex. any immediate customer reports?

maya: grabbing logs now. looks noisy from router and runtime. sample router errors: 
```
2026-03-17T06:12:18Z router-1 ERROR request_id=abc123 upstream=timeout status=504 route=/v1/generate latency=800ms
2026-03-17T06:12:19Z router-3 ERROR request_id=def456 upstream=alloc-failed status=503 detail=pool-saturated
2026-03-17T06:12:20Z runtime-4 WARN kvcache-miss model=q4-optimized memory-pressure=true
```

alex: checking autoscaler/HPA. pasted recent snapshot: 
```
$ kubectl get hpa inference-svc -n prod -o yaml
status:
  currentReplicas: 8
  desiredReplicas: 18
  currentMetrics:
    - type: Resource
      resource:
        name: cpu
        currentAverageUtilization: 92
spec:
  minReplicas: 4
  maxReplicas: 20
```

samir: GPU pool metrics from pool-2: total_gpus=64, allocated=60, pending_warmup=12, available=4. pod-creation backlog ~ 140 pods waiting to bind GPU. queue depth ~1800 req/s (baseline 200).

katie: customer impact: several customers seeing 503/504s, estimated 12% of requests failing during spike. Severity bumped. Spike start ~2026-03-17T06:12 UTC. Might correlate with scheduled model rollout at ~06:10.

maya: initial hypothesis: the q4-optimized model rollout increased GPU memory and per-token latency. New pods hit memory pressure on allocation -> alloc failures -> HPA fired but many replicas stuck initializing (warmup delay), resulting in queue accumulation and router timeouts. Also warmup probes weren't configured for rollout target.

ben: mitigation plan (executing now):
1) Pause/revert canary rollout and route traffic back to q3-light for 90% customers.
2) Patch HPA maxReplicas to 30 to allow faster scaling while warmup runs.
3) Trigger reserved-burst capacity request to infra (reserve 8 GPUs immediately).
4) For high-value customers, enable fallback to lite-model endpoint.

alex: running patch now: 
```
kubectl patch hpa inference-svc -n prod -p '{"spec":{"maxReplicas":30}}'
```

infra-bot: Action executed: HPA patched to maxReplicas=30 on inference-svc (user=alex). Reserved burst request submitted (ticket=INC-249876).

samir: evicting low-priority batch pods on pool-2 to free GPUs, freed ~4 GPUs in the last 2 mins. Initiating manual prewarm of 10 instances with q3-light.

maya: kicked warmup probes to new instances using the warmup endpoint. warmup probe logs: 
```
warmup-1 INFO probe=started model=q3-light latency=120ms
warmup-1 INFO probe=ok model=q3-light tokens_warm=512
```

katie: traffic shift started at 06:20 UTC to fallback routes, error rate falling: 12% -> 3.5% within 6 minutes. :thumbsup:

ben: good. keep monitoring. collecting traces, pprof from runtime, and kernel OOM logs. Uploading to S3 for RCA: s3://redwood-incident-logs/2498765432/ (traces + hpa-history + gpu-metrics).

maya: proposed timeline (fill details):
- 06:09 UTC: pre-rollout validation passed in staging
- 06:10 UTC: canary rollout to prod started (q4-optimized)
- 06:12 UTC: first router 504/503 observed, queue begins to grow
- 06:14 UTC: HPA observes CPU > 90%, desiredReplicas spikes to 18
- 06:15 UTC: pods fail to bind GPUs due to pool saturation -> alloc-failed errors
- 06:16 UTC: on-call pager triggers → current thread
- 06:18 UTC: manual reserved burst requested, HPA patched, prewarm started
- 06:20 UTC: traffic shifted to q3-light fallback for critical customers
- 06:24 UTC: error rate approaches baseline (~0.5-1%)

alex: adding infra notes: HPA metrics show a short window where desiredReplicas > available GPUs leading to a stabilization loop (scale up -> pods init -> warmup -> still high latency until warmup completes). Warmup duration for q4-optimized ~75s vs q3-light ~12s. That mismatch killed the fast-scaling feedback.

samir: GPU pool note: cloud provider had a delayed device attach event in region-a for a subset of nodes (~2-3 min), which compounded the warmup time. I've created cloud ticket referencing attach latency.

katie: customer impact record: 14 customers impacted, highest 503 spike for customer X at 06:13 UTC. CC: solutions-eng notified.

ben: actions assigned for RCA:
- maya -> collect and annotate logs + traces, produce model performance delta (q4 vs q3)
- alex -> HPA config review and autoscaler tuning suggestions (target metrics, cooldowns)
- samir -> GPU pool ops + prewarm automation + provider attach ticket
- katie -> customer impact log and comms + notify CS for outreach

infra-bot: INCIDENT: status changed -> RESOLVED at 2026-03-17T06:30:15Z. Root cause suspected: model rollout (q4-optimized) + insufficient warmup + GPU attach latency. Follow-up: full RCA doc to be created.

ben: handing off to postmortems channel. please create RCA doc and link this thread. I'll monitor for next 60 mins then close watch. Thanks all for fast moves.

maya: I'll start the RCA doc and include timeline + logs + proposed action items: (1) strengthen canary gating for memory/latency delta, (2) shorter warmup or background pre-provisioning for heavy models, (3) HPA tuning + global cap for safe fallback, (4) automated reserved-burst on rollout spikes.

katie: adding follow-up task list and owners to the incident board.

ben: closing pager. leaving thread for RCA references.

incident-bot: NOTE: Thread archived to postmortems on resolution.
